# Crayon Roofing & Structures — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary

This batch of call recordings is a mixed bag — a large share is internal/operations chatter (Porter pickup/drop coordination, vehicle numbers, loading/unloading disputes, driver instructions, "location anuppunga" navigation calls, GPS/location-finding, payment-follow-up with own staff, cyber-crime/Facebook-hack side conversation, Porter customer-support scripts about damaged goods). These were excluded from analysis per instructions.

The **genuine sales/dealer calls** that remain are still fairly numerous and give a reasonably clear picture of how Crayon Roofing & Structures (also referred to in calls as "Crayon Roofing and Structures," "Cryon," "Kriyaan") sells. The company is **not a pure roofing-sheet company** — it is a metal/building-materials distributor-cum-fabricator whose product mix, as actually discussed on calls, spans: colour-coated roofing sheets (various brands), plain/profile GI-GP sheets, polycarbonate sheets, roofing accessories (ridge, L-flash, crimp), Z-purlins, welding electrodes (Tata), screws, cutting & grinding wheels, and a small amount of MS pipe/structural enquiry. Rates, stock, and brand-switching (JSW / Coloron Plus / Pragathi / Kalaram Plus / Indra Dhanush / Radiance / Silver-on Plus) dominate the real sales talk. Because genuine "new customer acquisition" pitches are rare — most calls are rate-confirmation, repeat-order, or dealer-channel calls — this KB leans heavily on real quoted numbers and real objection-handling patterns rather than invented scripts.

## Products & brand ladder

Based only on what is mentioned in calls:

- **Colour-coated roofing/profile sheets (GI/GP, AZ150 base)** — the core product.
  - **JSW** – base steel; dealer explicitly says "Tata brand இல்ல, நம்மகிட்ட JSW தான் இருக்கு" [we don't have Tata, we only have JSW].
  - **Coloron Plus** – JSW's branded colour-coated line, "15 years warranty," positioned as the premium/flagship product ("Coloron Plus நல்ல branded sir").
  - **Silver-on Plus** – positioned as a step below Coloron Plus / AZ150 category, explained as cheaper alternative to market "silver iron."
  - **Pragathi / Pragathi Plus** – a separate, lower-cost running line, frequently out of stock ("Pragathi stock இல்ல, 2-3 நாள் ஆகும்").
  - **Kalaram Plus** – another brand name used interchangeably with Coloron Plus in several calls for rate quoting.
  - **Radiance** – mentioned mainly as a *competitor* brand customers get quotations from ("Radiance quotation வாங்கி இருக்காங்க… அதனால competition-ல போகுது").
  - **Indra Dhanush / "Asian" (Asian Dhanush)** – a cheaper/thinner (0.40–0.45mm) line for price-sensitive buyers.
  - **Non-colour sheet** (plain silver, 0.40/0.50mm) – no coating, cheapest tier.
- **Polycarbonate sheets** – two sub-types explained carefully to confused customers:
  - **Multi-wall** (hollow, usually 6mm) – not fully transparent front-to-back.
  - **Solid** (compact, 4/5/6mm) – true see-through, used for partitions/cabins. Width standard ~1200mm/4ft.
- **Roofing accessories** – Ridge (closure/standard ridge), L-Flash, crimp-end sheets, with separate pricing logic ("accessories manual-ஆ, time ஆகும்").
- **Z-purlins / "perlins"** – structural roof support member, handled by a separate person ("Kamal sir handle பண்றாரு").
- **Welding consumables** – Tata-branded welding rods/electrodes (2.5mm, box = 12 packets), cutting & grinding wheels.
- **Fasteners** – self-drilling screws (1", 1.5", bulk boxes of ~1000–2000 nos).
- **Pipes** – only **MS pipe / CHS-type pipe** confirmed available; PVC downpipe explicitly **not** offered ("PVC வராது Ma'am").
- **Wall/cabin panels** – one enquiry for "wall pass panel," handled as a generic metal-roofing-sheet variant query.

No evidence in these calls of trusses, purlins-as-a-structural-system, or any non-metal product line beyond the above.

## Real rates & terms (only rates that actually appear in the calls)

- Coloron Plus 0.47mm: **₹435 + GST per square meter** (quoted multiple times; later negotiated/revised to ₹425, ₹415, ₹410 in different calls as "market rate" moved).
- Coloron Plus 0.50mm plain sheet: **₹405 + GST/sqm**; profile rate **₹435 + GST/sqm**.
- Coloron Plus (off-white), kg basis: **₹113–114 + tax/kg**; same product as **₹420–430/sqm**.
- Pragathi / Pragathi Plus: **₹380–385/sqm**; kg basis **₹102/kg**.
- Kalaram Plus: **₹425/sqm**, kg basis **₹113/kg**.
- Indra Dhanush (Asian), 45 thickness: **₹91–93 + tax/kg**; running-meter weight ~3.6–3.9 kg/m (customer pushed back when weight looked light).
- Polycarbonate solid 5mm: **38 × 5 = ₹190/sqft + GST**.
- Polycarbonate multi-wall 6mm: **₹32/sqft + GST**.
- Polycarbonate 2mm sheet: **₹800 + GST/sqm**.
- Tata welding rod, 2.5mm: **₹336/packet (incl. tax)**, 12 packets/carton; quoted elsewhere as **₹285 + tax/packet** base; **bulk discount available above 10 cartons**.
- Rate volatility is explicit and frequent: "kg-ல ₹1 ஏறி இருக்கு, square meter-ல ₹5 ஏறி இருக்கு" [kg up by ₹1, sqm up by ₹5] — and staff are told **"இன்னைக்கு போட்டா மட்டும்தான் பழைய rate"** [old rate only if order placed today].
- Minimum order for SMP-coat tender-rate enquiries: **5,000 sqm minimum**, and "Sir தான் Ma'am price கொடுக்கணும்" [only Sir/the boss can quote that].
- Delivery/production lead time quoted as **7–8 days for bulk L-Flash/accessory orders**, same-day to next-day for ready-stock plain sheets.
- Credit-period references: "1 week credit போய் 13 days ஆயிடுச்சு" — standard credit term appears to be ~1 week, chased after.

## Objection Playbook

- **"Rate ஏறிடுச்சு, ஏன் இப்போ அதிகமா சொல்றீங்க?"** [Why is rate suddenly higher?]
